nina_marketing: Quick final: we plan to announce tomorrow 11:00 PT. Need one-line headline, one bench stat, final docs URL, rollout start time, and confirmation sales tagging works. @leo_engineering @ana_docs @carl_product @zara_salesops

leo_engineering: Rollout schedule OK. Start 10:15 PT with 10% canary for 10m, 40% for 20m, full by 11:00 PT if healthy. Will watch p95 and error rate. No infra holds.

ana_docs: Docs ready at https://docs.redwood-inference.com/releases/v2-3. Changelog and migration snippet live at /v2-3/changelog. Added quantization FAQ and troubleshooting note.

carl_product: Bench callout: median cost per token down ~22% on our chat trace; p95 latency improved ~10%. Suggest marketing wording: "reduces token cost by up to 25% on common workloads". Also recommend webinar CTA for Thurs 9am PT.

nina_marketing: We'll use "up to 25%". Headline options: "v2.3: lower token costs and faster responses" or "Cut inference costs up to 25% with v2.3". Leaning second. Need a perf image link.

leo_engineering: Both fine. I've uploaded perf PNG to shared drive: https://drive.redwood.com/marketing/v2-3-perf.png. Alt: "cost and latency comparison v2.2 vs v2.3"

zara_salesops: Sales ops: web form tag will be "launch_v2_3" and route to "AEs_inbound". I will run a quick post-send smoke test.

deploy-bot: Release pipeline queued by leo_engineering at 1891234568. CI: https://ci.redwood.com/builds/54001

nina_marketing: Final checklist: headline (use second), bench stat (up to 25%), docs link (ana), perf image (leo), sales tag (zara). We'll send 11:00 PT. Any blockers?

leo_engineering: No blockers. Monitoring dashboards ready; will post live status.

zara_salesops: I'll confirm tagging after send and report back here.

deploy-bot: Release started at 1891234580. Canary deployed.

nina_marketing: Announcement queued for 11:00 PT. Posting back when live. Thanks everyone :rocket:
